verses.text: Ha jun syalkan tik ix uji ayik ayoch winhaj Asuero reyal t'a Persia. 127 makanhil yaj smakb'en winh chi', skot t'a India masanto sk'och t'a Etiopía.
Haxo t'a chonhab' Susa, hata' ay spalacio winh rey chi'.

Ayik yoxil ab'il yoch winhaj Asuero chi' reyal, ix yak'an jun niwan wa'el winh t'a heb' niwak winak ayoch yajalil yet'ok, haton heb' yajalil heb' soldado yik Persia, heb' yik Media, heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' ayoch yajalil t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh chi'.
Nanhal ab'il wal ix yak' jun k'inh chi' winh, yik sch'oxanel jantak sb'eyumal winh yet' sniwanil yelk'och yopisio winh t'a heb' awtab'il chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch ukexo k'uhal k'inh winh t'a yamak'il spalacio. Masanil heb' ayek' t'a chonhab' Susa chi', heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, ix awtaj heb' smasanil.

Te wach' ix aj sb'o b'aj ix och k'inh chi'. Ha k'apak saksak k'apak yet' k'apak ya'ax ix och scortina'ilok. Hanhejtona' pax k'apak lino saksak yet' k'apak k'ik' mutz'inak ayoch sch'anhalok pax k'apak cortina chi'. Yamb'il k'apak yuj k'e'en argolla nab'a plata ayoch t'a juntzanh k'e'en oy nab'a mármol. Haxo xila, a k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata ayoch t'ay. Haxo t'a sat lu'um, a k'e'en mármol ayem t'ay, ay k'e'en saksak, ay k'e'en k'ik'ik'.
Haxo juntzanh waso nab'a oro syuk'lab'ej heb'. Ch'okch'ok yilji junjun waso chi'. Te niwan wino ix el t'a sk'ol winh rey chi' yak'ani.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ak'an serwil winh to malaj junok mach tz'ak'chaj pural yuk'an wino chi', junjun heb' syal yuk'an heb' jantak snib'ej.
Hanhejtona' pax ix reina Vasti, ix schek pax b'ochaj jun niwan wa'el ix t'a spalacio winh rey chi' yik wach' swa heb' ix ix awtab'il.

Ha wal t'a yukil k'uhal k'inh chi', ix te tzalaj sk'ol winh rey chi' yuj wino. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at ukwanh heb' winh yak'umal serwil winh, heb' winh ayoch yipok sk'ol winh, haton winhaj Mehumán, winhaj Bizta, winhaj Harbona, winhaj Bigta, winhaj Abagta, winhaj Zetar yet' winhaj Carcas.

Ix chekjib'at heb' winh yik b'at yik'ankot ix reina Vasti chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', yujto snib'ej winh sjawi ix yet' scorona kopopi yilji, yik sch'oxanpaxel swach'il yilji ix t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima yet' t'a yichanh heb' niwak yajal, yujto te wach' yilji ix.
Palta maj stak'kotlaj sb'a ix. Ix stenek' ix tas ix b'at yal heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' ix te kot yowal winh rey chi'.

Ix yawtankot ukwanh heb' winh niwak yopisio t'a Media yet' t'a Persia chi' winh, heb' winh yipk'olal yaj yuj winh: Haton winhaj Carsena, winhaj Setar, winhaj Admata, winhaj Tarsis, winhaj Meres, winhaj Marsena yet' winhaj Memucán. Ha heb' winh chi', yojtak ley heb' winh sik'lab'il, yuj chi' t'a heb' winh ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' tas tz'aj jun chi' sb'o'i.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Icha syal ko ley, naek wet'ok ¿tas yowalil tz'aj ix reina Vasti chi', yujto maj sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il ix, ix b'at yal heb' winh in chekab'? xchi winh.

Ha wal t'a yichanh masanil heb' molan chi', ix yalan winhaj Memucán t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a ix reina Vasti chi', manhoknhej t'ayach ix och smul ix, palta ix ochpax smul ix t'ayonh a onh niwak yajal onh tik yet' t'a masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a yol a makb'en tik.

Ha tas ix sk'ulej ix chi' ol yab' masanil heb' ix ix, ol sk'ayb'an heb' ix, manhxa ol aj yelk'och heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix t'a yol sat, ol am yalan heb' ix icha tik: Ha winhaj rey Asuero ix awtan ix reina Vasti, palta maj sk'anab'ajejlaj ix sb'ati, xcham heb' ix.

Ha heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh niwak yajal t'a Persia yet' t'a Media tik, ayik ol yab'an heb' ix tas ix yutej sb'a ix reina chi', ol laj yalan heb' ix t'a heb' winh yetb'eyum. Yuj chi' a yuj jun tik ol spatikejel heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, haxo skot yowal heb' winh chi' t'a heb' ix.

Yuj chi' jun mamin rey, tato wach' skan jun tik t'ayach, ak' tz'ib'chaj junok ley yik skan leyal t'a Persia yet' t'a Media tik, to maxtzak yal yek'b'ati: Manhxa b'ak'inh sjawi ix reina Vasti t'a yichanh winh rey, xchiokab' jun ley chi'. Haxo junokxo ix ek'to swach'il t'a yichanh ix chi', a ix tz'ochkan reina'il sk'exulok ix.
Ha jun ley chi' yowalil tz'ak'chaj ojtakajel t'a masanil yol a makb'en tik yik wach' masanil heb' ix ix ol sk'anab'ajej wal heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, yalnhej tas anima'il, xchi winh.
Ha jun ix yal winhaj Memucán chi', ix scha wal sk'ol winh rey chi' yet' masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh, ix och t'a yopisio yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix schekan winh tz'ib'chajb'at t'a junjun makan t'a yol smakb'en chi', t'a sti' junjun chonhab'. Ix yalanb'at winh to ayokab' yelk'och heb' winh winak t'a yol spat, aokab' heb' winh tz'alani tastak sb'o'i.
